newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania Bancorex signs syndicated loan accord.
newsitem.headline: Romania Bancorex signs syndicated loan accord.

text.p: Romanian state bank Banca Romana de Comert Exterior (Bancorex) signed on Thursday an accord on a $75 million syndicated loan -- the first such deal for a Romanian commercial bank -- arranged by CS First Boston.
Co-arranger of the loan, which involves another 16 foreign banks as lead managers, managers and participants, is Union Bank of Switzerland.
The three-year loan has an 18-month intermediate maturity and bears an annual interest rate based on LIBOR with a 1.625 percent margin, Bancorex said.
It said the initial loan request for $50 million rose to $75 million thanks to strong interest during subscription.
"This accord opens a new era in the relations between Romanian commercial banks and the international banking community," Bancorex chairman Florin Ionescu said during the signing ceremony.
Ionescu said Bancorex would use the money for various needs, "chiefly to finance energy imports".
Bancorex specialises in foreign trade financing and handles the bulk of foreign exchange trading on the local market.
Romania rejoined international capital markets in 1995, after more than a decade of absence, with syndicated loans for the central bank.
